newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index falls more than 150 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index falls more than 150 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average fell more than 150 points Thursday, in a relentless sell-off after robust February retail sales data revived fears of an interest rate increase by the Federal Reserve.

At about 3:45 p.m. EST (2045 GMT), the Dow was off 151.24 points or more than 2 percent at 6,888.13, extending Wednesday's decline after setting record highs the previous two sessions. The New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading were activated early in the session when the Dow fell more than 50 points.
